name: InterContinental Washington D.C. - The Wharf
insider_take: This waterfront marvel sits on the historic Potomac River, where luxury meets the vibrant energy of DC's newest entertainment district.
whats_special: The InterContinental Washington D.C. - The Wharf is the first luxury hotel to open directly on the Potomac River in over 50 years. Located in the $2.5 billion Southwest Waterfront development, it features stunning river views and is built on land that was once home to the city's bustling fish markets in the 1800s.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on floors 8-10 for unobstructed views of the Potomac and the perfect sunrise backdrop over the Washington Channel.
dont_miss: Step outside to explore The Wharf's mile-long promenade featuring over 20 restaurants, live music venues, and water taxis that connect directly to Georgetown and Old Town Alexandria. The nearby Maine Avenue Fish Market, America's oldest continuously operating fish market since 1805, is just steps away.
pros: Prime waterfront location at The Wharf with stunning Potomac River views
Modern luxury amenities and contemporary design throughout
Walking distance to National Mall and Smithsonian museums
Vibrant dining and entertainment district at your doorstep
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury waterfront location
Busy tourist area with high foot traffic
